text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tomorrow is finally the day of the Satsuki Sho. However, the weather forecast is looking bleak.
choice_data_list: Looks like a storm might be on the way…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It does seem that way. But don't worry! I have a strategy to deal with poor track conditions!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond responds with reassuring composure. Still, to be on the safe side, we decide to leave the academy early tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's not much rain the following morning, but the strong winds are relentless and show no signs of letting up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The strong winds are likely to cause the trains to stop running. With that in mind, we decide to take a taxi to Nakayama Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, the weather has also backed up traffic considerably. I was planning to be at the racecourse by now, but we still haven't gotten off the highway.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When we make it off the highway, the regular roads are also backed up. At this rate, we're not going to make it in time!
choice_data_list: You've got to get out and run the rest of the way!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Okay! I'll see you there!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ngh! The wind is so strong!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She gets knocked back by the gusts. Spring storms are rare this time of year. For one to delay us in traffic like this, it's almost as if…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (An unusual storm and heavy traffic… Why does everything have to go wrong today of all days?)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (Could this be… the jinx?)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (At this rate, I might not make it in time for the race at all. And even if I do, I won't be able to run well with these frazzled nerves!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (Could the jinx be trying to stop me from achieving greatness?!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (…! I'm not going to let that happen!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond lets out a fierce cry and tears off down the exclusive Umamusume lane.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I arrive at Nakayama Racecourse with only thirty minutes to go before the Satsuki Sho is scheduled to start.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I head for the paddock, praying she made it on time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I look around for her, and…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Phew…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh! Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes! I made it just in the nick of time!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: The weather has thrown me for a little bit of a loop, but I think that actually helped me stay calm!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond grins in an incredible display of mental fortitude.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: This is the first race of the Classic Triple Crown… I absolutely can't afford to lose here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As if summoned by her determination, the sun makes a dazzling entrance, banishing the storm clouds.
